sampler_proof.component_probability: theta_l B_l / B; B=sum_l theta_l B_l
sampler_proof.different_estimator: Choosing by theta_l and weighting each draw B_l has second moment sum_l theta_l B_l^2, whereas canonical constant weight has B^2; difference=sum_{l<m} theta_l theta_m (B_l-B_m)^2.
